observation_statement: ∀ (s : State) (who amount : Nat), depositAllowed s who amount → (deposit s who amount).collateral who = s.collateral who + amount
proof:
by
  intro s who amount allowed
  unfold deposit
  rw [if_pos allowed]
  show (put s.collateral who (s.collateral who + amount)) who = s.collateral who + amount
  have hput : (put s.collateral who (s.collateral who + amount)) who = s.collateral who + amount := by simp [put]
  exact hput
reasoning: A successful deposit credits exactly the deposited amount to the caller collateral mapping.
